The '''Thyferran Home Defense Corps uniform''' was the official uniform worn by [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]] officers.<ref name="The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]], during the [[Bacta War]], an [[Ashern]] strike team [[Raid on the Dlarit estate|infiltrated]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aerin Dlarit]]'s [[Dlarit estate|estate]]. The strike team found Dlarit asleep on his office chair wearing his finest Thyferran Home Defense Corps uniform. As a way to destabilize the regime of former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]'s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], the strike team stripped Dlarit of his uniform and circulated a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the deed, causing the Thyferran Home Defense Corps officers to be treated with scorn by their fellow [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].<ref name="The Bacta War" />
